items.title: Louis Gallaud Interview, 1960-03-18
items.q: Basin and Bienville by Louis White there.

ctx.x: You were talking about Jones was the bass player.

Oh, yeah, that's George Jones. He used to get all the jobs around there and play. That's the time, that's the old time. He used to play guitar and bass too and sing, you know. He was in a, during the time, Cornelius, Washington, and them used to have a, all them cabarets around, uh, uh, Basin and, uh, in Bienville. Basin and Bienville by Louis White there. And, uh, he used to play in that place there. And I used to play for Harris Stilley too at Countdown in Bourbon. And also at Corndown in St. Louis for Harris…
